## Hinge question {#fm6-hinge .fm-slide }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="4" class="hinge fm-hinge"><p class="hinge-question">A tank is modelled by <span data-math="V=8000(0.92)^t">V=8000(0.92)^t</span>, where <span data-math="V">V</span> is in litres and <span data-math="t">t</span> is in hours. What does the model mean?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span>The tank loses 8 litres each hour.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span>The tank loses 92% of its current water each hour.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>The tank loses 640 litres every hour.</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span>The tank loses 8% of its current water each hour.</span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>4. The multiplier 0.92 retains 92% each hour, so 8% of the current volume is lost.</div></div>
```

::: notes
Additional diagnostic question. Default 60 seconds. Students begin with a fist on their chest, think independently, and show 1–4 fingers simultaneously on your verbal “show” cue. Collect responses before revealing. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer.

Correct answer: 4.
1: reads a percentage as a fixed number of litres.
2: confuses the proportion retained with the proportion lost.
3: applies the first hour's loss, 640 L, as a constant loss in every hour.

Ready: ask what changes in the second hour and move to Example 4.6.
Divided: ask pairs to explain what 0.92 and 8000 each represent, then re-poll.
Further explanation needed: calculate the first two opening volumes (8000, 7360) and compare their 8% losses (640, 588.8). Re-poll before the water-tank example.
:::
